# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
3. Using the structural models, you can find different structural defects and record them accurately for maintenance reporting.
4. You must also ensure to have the necessary equipment and tools with you to carry out maintenance tasks effectively.
5. It is important to take detailed measurements to locate the defects precisely.
6. Record all your findings in a clear and detailed manner for the maintenance report.
7. If there are any safety concerns, please inform the relevant supervisor and make necessary precautions.
